primary_domain: ordinary Manual primary target, separately by n, m, original design/current background requirement and data origin
secondary_domain: other admitted target, never pooled with primary target
estimand: C minus A for an exact same-image/reference/n/m/common-D AC pair
existing_cohort: conditional analysis of stored teams that remain legal under current LOBO labels; not uniform current-class resampling
new_cohort: registered capacity-gap supplement reported separately; no outcome-dependent team selection
reversed_pairs: each physical unordered pair is one evidence unit; reverse directions are exact algebraic views, not independent replication
weights: legacy and reused strict-ABC legs: deduplicate physical pair within each condition, then target-pool mean; new capacity-gap cohort: D-background means within each frozen XZ block, then XZ-block means within target pool; then targets within image and images. Image-equal and building-equal estimands are separate. New-cohort pair-equal weighting is an explicit sensitivity only.
positive_negative_counts: strict sign using numerical tolerance 1e-10; substantive up/down/small use +/-1 Q
uncertainty: 2000 building-cluster bootstrap draws, deterministic condition-derived seed; percentile 95% intervals; sparse support explicitly labeled

support_tiers.sparse: positive support below the supported threshold

missing_Q: retain missing values and native score status; never impute zero
human_order: only exact approved existing endpoint bindings; no new forced order or coordinate change
component_support: Q-common support for comparability, plus separately labeled native component availability; no metric denominator substitution
ceiling_relation: M=(Q_A+Q_C)/2 implies abs(delta_Q)<=2*min(M,100-M); a high-M association can reflect scale compression and does not prove a class or voting mechanism
within_image_association: same image, n, m and class-pair; describe rank correlation between symmetric level and absolute difference when at least five unique physical pairs and nonconstant data
same_node_count: equal selected-node counts do not establish equal correspondence, order, shape, position or boundaries; evaluate stored direct geometric distances and quality components
difficulty_structure: freeze current labels, reference-derived structural conditions and room-purpose index; cross-cells descriptive with explicit image/building support
time_whole_team: all A and C member records positive and complete, same single legal recording source; no missing-time imputation
time_blocks: X and Z complete positive same-source records identify T_Z-T_X even if common D labor is unavailable; label as replacement-block recorded labor only
time_other_targets: source annotation labor only if target-specific time is absent; never relabel as target-specific duration
